topography.project_purpose: The Magpie Ecosystem is a multi-chain yield aggregation and liquid restaking platform that enables users to deposit assets into specialized sub-protocols (e.g., Cakepie, Eigenpie, Penpie) to earn enhanced yields and governance power. It leverages veTokenomics and liquid staking derivatives to maximize returns across various DeFi protocols.
topography.relationship_narrative: All product families share a common architecture of yield-optimizing vaults that issue liquid derivative tokens and distribute rewards via the Magpie Ecosystem's governance token (MGP). They are deployed across multiple chains by a centralized deployer cluster, indicating a unified development and management framework.
